-Total asset value on the network hit the $800M mark recently (this is an increase of 54% YTD!)…
-Defi TVL on Mantle grew 44% over the last month!
-@blockmachineHQ ‘s Mantle RPC went live…
-@mETHProtocol recently crossed 1M $ETH staked since launch!
-@xStocksFi continues to generate massive success with tokenized equities, now with over 700 tokenized stocks and over $750M in AUM…

-And @OpenstockInc settled its first onchain IPO vault!
There are tons of other cool things going on as well, so make sure to read all about them here [ https://substack.com/redirect/5c92888d-3b14-4b5a-990d-c6cd0626994d?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and stay tuned for more information going forward!
Also, Mantle will be at Token2049 in Singapore (see below!), so make sure to check them out if you attend it!
And, as always, make sure to follow @Mantle_Official [ https://substack.com/redirect/e3115441-46e0-45a7-9393-a652979b4a63?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] on Twitter/X for more updates!
